novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that "only a small fraction of CoT tokens are 'load-bearing'" because their hidden states are "causally consumed by downstream layers," and proposes characterizing them through attention read-out and residual-stream ablation. Searches using "causal token importance chain-of-thought pruning," "necessary CoT steps causal intervention," and "attention token pruning long reasoning" identify the closest work as Causal Sufficiency and Necessity Improves Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (2025), which already uses interventions to identify indispensable reasoning steps and automatically prune redundant ones, alongside Causal Abstraction for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Arithmetic Word Problems (2023), which tests whether intermediate CoT tokens causally affect answers. Moving from causal necessity at the reasoning-step level to per-token hidden-state ablation and an online stopping probe is a natural, somewhat narrower mechanistic operationalization using standard interpretability tools, rather than a new core relationship; the exact token-level instance is differentiated, but the central causal-pruning hypothesis is substantially anticipated.
